_note: Studio presets for /living-painting, written by the studio (2026-11-14). The method follows the public Skale Out tutorial (learn.skaleout.com/animation-styles); every scene and description here is the studio's own wording. medium = how it must look; motion = how this medium is allowed to move.

watercolour.name: Watercolour
watercolour.scene: A lotus pond at dawn seen from above: two white egrets wade between floating leaves while small fish dart under the surface.
watercolour.medium: Transparent watercolour on rough cold-press paper: layered washes, blooms where wet paint met wet paint, hard dried edges, granulating pigment, a few splatters, white paper left for the brightest lights. A small palette: cool jade water, warm peach light, white birds.
watercolour.action: The egrets step slowly and one dips its beak; the fish flick in short bursts; leaves turn a little; ring ripples open from the legs and the beak.
watercolour.motion: Ripples are broken painted rings that fade as they widen. Paint layers move; the paper texture stays fixed to the frame.

mosaic.name: Stone mosaic
mosaic.scene: A dolphin circles a stone floor of waves and shells, seen from above.
mosaic.medium: A floor mosaic of small cut stones (about 12 px on the 1080 px canvas) laid in rows that follow every outline, dark grout between them, each stone a slightly different shade with a faint bevel light. Earth palette: ochre, brick, sea green, slate, cream, one gold glass stone.
mosaic.action: The dolphin glides in a slow arc with strong tail beats; light from above wanders over the tiles as if through water.
mosaic.motion: The animal is its own layer of stones moving over a fixed floor. Stones never melt or slide through each other; light moves as a shimmer of brighter stones.

sumi_e.name: Ink wash (sumi-e)
sumi_e.scene: A heron flies over layered misty peaks toward a pale red moon.
sumi_e.medium: Black ink wash on thin rice paper: values from solid black to the palest grey, wet bleeding edges, dry-brush streaks, large areas of empty paper and mist. The moon is the only colour.
sumi_e.action: The heron flies with full, slow wingbeats, rising and falling, while ridge after ridge slides past and the mist drifts across them.
sumi_e.motion: Mist blooms and thins like wet wash. Ridges are brush strokes in depth layers; the nearest slide fastest.

impasto.name: Impasto oil
impasto.scene: A fishing boat climbs a huge storm wave under a torn sky, gulls wheeling above.
impasto.medium: Thick impasto oil: palette-knife slabs and bristle strokes that follow the forms, raised ridges catching light, broken colour instead of flat fills, canvas weave showing where the paint is thin. Original, not a copy of any known painting.
impasto.action: The wave lifts the boat to its crest and lets it slide down; spray flies off the crest; the gulls bank against the wind.
impasto.motion: Waves roll as moving knife strokes, spray is flicked dabs of thick paint. The canvas weave stays fixed to the frame.

nocturne_gouache.name: Night gouache
nocturne_gouache.scene: A fox trots along a moonlit village lane while lanterns sway in the trees.
nocturne_gouache.medium: Opaque matte gouache, dark blues and greens laid in flat layers with visible bristle marks, moonlight as a thin pale edge on the fox, lanterns as warm opaque dabs with a soft painted halo.
nocturne_gouache.action: The fox trots in, pauses and turns its head; lanterns swing gently; moths circle the light; clouds slide over the moon.
nocturne_gouache.motion: Light is painted, not a digital glow: halos brighten and dim as dabs. Brush texture travels with each object; paper grain stays fixed.

botanical.name: Botanical plate
botanical.scene: A hummingbird moth visits jasmine and marigold laid out like a scientific plate.
botanical.medium: A botanical plate: fine ink outlines, soft watercolour fills on cream paper, plants arranged airy and legible like a field guide, fine vein lines in wings and leaves.
botanical.action: The moth hovers from flower to flower with fast blurred wings, sips, and moves on; stems bend under it and spring back.
botanical.motion: Lines never flicker: a wing at one angle always looks the same. Stems bend from the base like real stems.

paper_cut.name: Paper cut diorama
paper_cut.scene: A paper whale rises through a stack of cut-paper ocean layers while lantern fish drift past.
paper_cut.medium: 6 to 9 layers of cut paper from pale surface blue to near black, each casting a soft shadow on the next, visible fibre and slightly uneven blade edges. Translucent tissue pieces glow where light passes through.
paper_cut.action: The whale rises slowly with a lazy tail beat; layers slide at different speeds like a multiplane camera; the fish part around it; paper flakes drift down.
paper_cut.motion: Everything is paper: pieces slide, hinge, fold and curl, never melt. Strips twist to show their paler back.

art_nouveau.name: Art Nouveau poster
art_nouveau.scene: A peacock turns on a branch inside an ornamental arch of vines.
art_nouveau.medium: A lithograph poster: flowing whiplash lines, a heavy dark outline on every shape, flat muted fills (sage, olive, ochre, cream, deep teal), a patterned halo, stylised leaves growing into the frame, aged paper. No lettering.
art_nouveau.action: The peacock turns its head and fans its train open, the vines sway and the halo pattern turns slowly.
art_nouveau.motion: Shapes move as clean outlined pieces, like the print come alive. Paper texture stays fixed to the frame.

golden_hour.name: Golden hour gouache
golden_hour.scene: A kite flies over a mustard field at sunset while a boy runs along the field edge.
golden_hour.medium: Warm opaque gouache: low sun turning the field gold and orange, long soft shadows, hazy sky, visible brush texture.
golden_hour.action: The kite dips and climbs on its string, the boy runs and looks up, the mustard rolls in waves of wind.
golden_hour.motion: The field bends in waves of painted strokes. Brush texture travels with each object; paper grain stays fixed.

anime_background.name: Hand-painted anime background
anime_background.scene: Two original children cycle down a hill road through green fields under towering summer clouds.
anime_background.medium: A hand-painted animation background in gouache: lush greens, big white cumulus clouds in deep blue sky, tiny flowers in the grass, visible brush texture; characters in clean simple lines and soft flat colour. Original characters and an original look, not a copy of any studio or film.
anime_background.action: The camera tracks beside them; the girl looks back and laughs; hair, clothes and grass flutter; clouds drift.
anime_background.motion: Characters are drawn on twos (a new pose every 2 frames); background layers slide at different speeds.

madhubani.name: Madhubani
madhubani.scene: A pair of fish circle under a lotus while a peacock dances on the bank.
madhubani.medium: Madhubani: bold double black outlines, flat red, yellow, indigo and green, every shape filled with fine line patterns (scales, hatching, dots), a thick decorated border, handmade paper.
madhubani.action: The fish circle each other, the peacock lifts and spreads its tail, the lotus opens a little, water lines ripple.
madhubani.motion: Shapes move as outlined pieces with their patterns fixed inside them. The border and paper stay fixed to the frame.

miniature.name: Indian miniature
miniature.scene: A royal elephant walks along a palace terrace at dusk with lamps being lit.
miniature.medium: Rajasthani-Mughal miniature: gouache on burnished paper, fine brush outlines, jewel colours (lapis, vermilion, gold, malachite), patterned textiles, a flat tilted perspective and a painted border.
miniature.action: The elephant walks with a swaying gait, its trunk curling; lamps flicker on one by one; pigeons lift off the parapet.
miniature.motion: Figures move as painted cut-outs on the flat terrace; flames are small painted tongues that flicker; border and paper stay fixed.

warli.name: Warli
warli.scene: A circle of villagers dances around a drummer under a crescent moon.
warli.medium: Warli: white rice-paste figures (circles and triangles, stick limbs) on a red-brown mud wall, simple trees and huts, slightly uneven hand-painted strokes, the wall's earthen grain.
warli.action: The dancers step and sway in a turning spiral, the drummer beats, trees sway, the moon glows.
warli.motion: Figures change pose in simple stick-figure steps on twos; the wall texture stays fixed.

diwali_gouache.name: Diwali night gouache
diwali_gouache.scene: Rows of diyas glow on a courtyard rangoli while sparklers trace light and a cat watches from the steps.
diwali_gouache.medium: Opaque gouache night scene: deep indigo, warm diya light as thick yellow-orange dabs with painted halos, the rangoli in bright powder colours, visible brush texture.
diwali_gouache.action: Flames flicker, sparkler trails draw arcs that fade, the cat's tail swishes, a few sparks float up.
diwali_gouache.motion: Light is painted dabs that brighten and fade, never a digital bloom. Paper grain stays fixed.
